svg.title: Hyouga Yui — Nine Hells Frozen. Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Permafrost Heart forks into Weight of the Avalanche then Buried in the Avalanche, or Deepening Frost then The Glacier Advances. Cocytus Vigil forks into Cracks in the Ice then Nine Hells Opened, or Rime Mantle then Locked in Cocytus. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu.

Decrease Damage Taken 35% on Cocytus and 30% on Glacier's Will's tiles)","tertiary":"Self amplification (Increase Damage Given 35% on Cerulean Storm: Avalanche and Glacier's Will beside the 25% + 0.15/level bloodline passive); same +10% band as the secondaries, ranked by role, not size","rationale":"Damage is the broadest tag: three Ice rows at 40/45 EP on radius-1 circle strikes (Nine Hell's Spear, Glacial Shatter: Purgatory, Cerulean Storm: Avalanche), all ENEMIES-only, so burst is the primary and the AOE trait's home. The Ground Control trait lives in Glacial Descent: Cocytus (35% exposure and 35% guard on one 40 AP cast), Nine Hell's Spear's 35% circle exposure and Glacier's Will's 30% ground guard, so Increase Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Taken form the secondary. Increase Damage Given sits on two 35% self rows (Avalanche, Glacier's Will) beside a bloodline passive of the same tag. All three percentage routes reach +10% on two rows, so below Damage the tiers are co-equal in size: control ranks above IDG because it spans two tags and its exposure lifts allies' hits, while IDG serves the caster alone. Wound, shield and move are unsupported. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +5, IDG +10%, IDT +10%, DDT +10%; not jointly attainable.","Recalibration from Draft 2: each capstone's primary rises from +2% to +5% (The Glacier Advances IDG, Nine Hells Opened IDT, Locked in Cocytus DDT), moving all three percentage routes from +7% to the +10% band; secondaries and every other node are unchanged. Row-weighted full builds now run 24\u201336; Burst (29) sits below the percentage-route examples (32\u201336) because Damage is hard-capped at +5.","Why a single-tag root: the self side carries only IDG (Avalanche, Glacier's Will) and DDT (Cocytus, Glacier's Will). Kit rows multiply the hit in turn when live, reductions in sequence with a floor of 10% of the hit (computeDamagePacket); the passive applies last. IDG, IDT and DDT skip pierce.","Delivery: all cooldown 7. Strikes: 60 AP, range 4, radius-1 circle on an OTHER_USER target, friendly fire ENEMIES. Cocytus: 40 AP, OPPONENT, IDT on the target, DDT on the caster. Glacier's Will: 40 AP, EMPTY_GROUND, range 5; IDG row SELF; DDT row an INHERIT FRIENDLY ground circle re-applied each round to caster and allies on the tiles; move row sorts last (\u00a74b). Buff/debuff rows are live in the two rounds after the cast round, never in it (\u00a73b), so no strike takes its own jutsu's buff.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Cocytus Vigil or Deepening Frost; Amplifier, Cocytus Vigil or Weight of the Avalanche; Exposure, Permafrost Heart or Rime Mantle; Lake warden, Cracks in the Ice or Permafrost Heart. 13 of 14 full builds are non-dominated (risk 6). Off-kit Ice coverage is unverified.","IDG stacking: both 35% self rows reach 45%. Avalanche (60 AP) and Glacier's Will (40 AP) fit one 100 AP turn (ENGINE_LAWS 61), so both are live for the same two rounds and compound to \u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.10 on hits matching both (\u00a73b) before the 25% + 0.15/level passive applies. Glacier's Will's row also reaches basic attacks, weapons and normal jutsu. Not simulated; normal-tree potency unapproved.","Exposure reach: Spear's exposure (no element) raises every non-pierce hit from the caster, allies and weapons on every enemy in its circle; Cocytus's (Highest, no element) raises element-less hits and elemental hits of the caster's highest offence stat on one target. Spear and Cocytus fit one turn (60 + 40 AP), so one enemy can carry \u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.10 exposure on hits both rows cover for two rounds. Pierce hits take no exposure or guard.","Guard scale: Cocytus's 35% self guard and Glacier's Will's 30% ground guard reach 45% and 40%; both fit one turn (40 + 40 AP), so a caster on the circle takes \u00d70.55 \u00d7 0.60 = \u00d70.33 on non-pierce hits while both are live (the two reductions compound). The ground guard is positional and covers allies on the tiles; its FRIENDLY re-application and first active round follow the dossier and \u00a74b, not a process.ts read.","Ally hazard: none on supported rows. All three Damage rows and Spear's exposure are friendly fire ENEMIES; Cocytus is an OPPONENT-target single cast; Glacier's Will's supported rows are SELF or FRIENDLY. The kit's only ally-hazard row is Spear's wound (friendly fire none) and its only enemy-hazard row is Glacier's Will's move; both are unsupported and unchanged.","Dominated allocation: 01,02,06,07 (+2 Damage, self buff +3%, exposure +5%, guard +2%) is dominated by 01,06,07,08, because Nine Hells Opened carries the same +2 Damage as Weight of the Avalanche; a player wanting both Hidden Arts' effects should buy the exposure capstone instead. Every node still appears in a non-dominated full build.","Delivery: three 60 AP strikes and two 40 AP supports, all cooldown 7, so a route's full value is realized over a seven-round cycle and the percentage routes pay only inside 2-round windows. Glacial Shatter: Purgatory is a D-rank record with the same 45 EP as the A-rank Spear, so the +5 Damage route raises it equally. No injected children, item gates, hidden jutsu or mode restrictions exist.","Context: skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in ranked PvP and sparring. The 15% Wind Decrease Damage Taken passive is a bloodline effect and is untouched. The IDG passive is 25% + 0.15/level (28.75% if scaled at level 25; level basis unverified). The tree equalises marginal opportunity against the reference, not final strength. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ice jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Descent Cocytus · Will · Hell's Spear (4 effects)
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Buried in the Avalanche path + Cocytus Vigil
The Glacier Advances path + Cocytus Vigil
Nine Hells Opened path + Permafrost Heart
Locked in Cocytus path + Cracks in the Ice
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE HYOUGA YUI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 3 / Ice classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 recalibration)
